gripOrHq.title: Disintegrator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [2]: Derez a piece of ice and end your run. Use this ability only when you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice and have successfully passed it.

gripOrHq.title: Black Widow
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. Choose an installed piece of ice when you install Black Widow. Black Widow gets +5 strength during each encounter with that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: All-Hands
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, access three additional cards from HQ. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

gripOrHq.title: Cortical Stimulators
gripOrHq.rulesText: Prevents 1 Net or brain damage each turn.

gripOrHq.title: Morphing Tool
gripOrHq.rulesText: [2]: Break a subroutine of the type last chosen for Morphing Tool. [1]: +1 strength. [1], A: Choose whether Morphing Tool breaks code gates, sentries, or walls. When you install Morphing Tool, choose whether it breaks code gates, sentries, or walls.

rig.title: Vienna 22
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Taxman
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Tax counter. Every two Tax counters cause the Corp to lose [1] at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Redecorator
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break up to two sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [3]: +1 strength

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

root.title: Systematic Layoffs
root.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.
